x: Below Rajahmundry the Godavari splits into the Gautami and Vasishta, which divide into seven branches (Gautami, Vasishta, Vainateya, Tulya, Bharadwaja, Kaushika, Athreya) before reaching the Bay of Bengal. 4 is not supported; 2 is only the first split.
